uncited: A variant where cache updates are driven by file server uploads.
Each frame, a user-defined number of brick data is uploaded to the GPU.
The global brick ID is translated to a local brick ID.
If the brick is EMPTY, the corresponding page in the multi-channel page-table hierarchy is marked as EMPTY.
When a brick is removed from the cache, its corresponding page is marked as UNMAPPED.
Choose it for web-based or networked rendering systems requiring incremental updates.
When a block is evicted from VRAM, it is transferred via D2H and inserted into the CPU cache.
Choose it for large-scale out-of-core optimization where SSD write latency would otherwise stall rendering.
*   Not suitable when hardware-specific features (like hardware LRU caches) are available and sufficient.
*   Not suitable when strict real-time performance is required and CPU-GPU synchronization overhead is prohibitive.
